messages:
maria: quick heads up — console team is planning to flip the default quota attribution from `model` -> `route` next week. affects hosted default routes, and will change which meter shows up in cost dashboards. :eyes:
ken: whoa — that sounds breaking for a lot of SDKs that currently assume per-model quotas. any timeline and migration path?
samir: timeline is Wed 2026-03-25 for canary, full rollout Thu 2026-04-01. we want a 2-week opt-in window via feature-flag in console. canary will be behind `routing_quota_v2` flag.
olga: UX question — are we exposing a migration CTA in the console per-tenant? migrating to route-attribution might need to map existing `model_id`s -> `route` tags.
maria: yes, console will show a mapping preview and a dry-run toggle. but we still need SDK compatibility because clients send route metadata via headers today and some languages embed it differently.
ken: specifically: python sdk sets `x-redwood-route` automatically when using Route.bind(), ts/go clients sometimes send `route_hint` in JSON body. we need to agree on a canonical header and a graceful fallback.
samir: proposal: canonical header is `x-rd-route` (short), SDKs should send that. if missing, servers will fall back to `x-redwood-model` mapping until migration window closes.
olga: ping @devex: can we surface deprecation warnings in the python/ts SDKs when the legacy header is used? ideally during the opt-in window only.
maria: @devex good ask. also need telemetry: per-token cost attribution needs to include both model and route tags for first 30 days to allow reconciliation.
ken: implementation constraints: runtime routing logic looks at headers in this order: `x-rd-route`, `x-redwood-route`, `x-redwood-model`. changing order could cause subtle SLO skew during canary.
samir: canary will enable `x-rd-route` precedence only for 5% of requests. we must ensure SDKs can opt into the new header without forcing releases immediately. suggest a `SDK_FLAG_SEND_RD_ROUTE=true` env var in new SDK builds.
olga: console rollout UX: when user flips migration preview, show affected quota and projected cost delta. also show which SDKs are sending the canonical header vs legacy ones.
ken: for the SDK release plan: python patch can detect `route` args and set `x-rd-route`. ts needs a minor bump. go maybe a patch. we should add telemetry ping to console that lists client user-agent + route header used.
maria: i'm worried about server-side metrics duplication during the overlap period (same request counted to model and route). we should add a dedupe key in tracing to avoid double-attribution in the console charts.
samir: agree — add a tracing tag `route_migration_key` equal to request_id. console aggregator should use that to collapse duplicates.
ken: one more incline: legacy customers using reserved capacity (Dedicated) might have quota enforcement tied to model id. need migration docs for Dedicated customers to map their commit lines.
olga: action items:
- devex: add deprecation warning + env flag in python/ts/go SDKs (maria will draft messages)
- eng-platform/runtime: implement `x-rd-route` precedence behind canary flag and dedupe trace tag (samir)
- console: migration preview + dry-run + cost projection (olga)
- releases: schedule SDK minor/patch releases to ship before canary (ken)
maria: i can draft a short migration guide and sample diff for py/ts to show `x-rd-route` header set.
ken: sample python snippet for devex docs (for preview):
```
# old
client = RedwoodClient(model="open-llama-13b")
# new (explicit route)
client = RedwoodClient(route="search-llama-13b")
# internally SDK will set header:
# x-rd-route: "search-llama-13b"
```
olga: perfect. add a note to the console UI: "Your current quota usage may temporarily appear in both Model and Route dashboards during migration."
maria: release-bot scheduled canary job: deploy/canary/routing-quota-v2 @ 2026-03-25 01:00 UTC — added to #release-calendar
release-bot: canary job queued: deploy/canary/routing-quota-v2 -> started on infra-canary-3
ken: OK — i'll start branch for py/ts changes and tag you all in PR. please keep changes small: env toggle + warning + header write.
samir: we'll wire the dedupe tag and ensure telemetry exports both attributes for 30 days.
olga: thanks everyone. i'll draft console UX mocks and ping infra for Dedicated quota mapping docs.
maria: 👍 will post the migration guide and an example PR link once ready. thanks! :rocket:
